theorems.name: Submission.p03_tkc_torsion_card_recurrence_68cf3476_d5
theorems.statement: ∀ (k : Type) [Field k] [CharZero k] [IsAlgClosed k] [DecidableEq k] (W : WeierstrassCurve k), W.Δ ≠ 0 → ∀ m : ℕ, 2 ≤ m → Nat.card {P : W.toAffine.Point // (m + 1) • P = 0} + Nat.card {P : W.toAffine.Point // (m - 1) • P = 0} = 2 * Nat.card {P : W.toAffine.Point // m • P = 0} + 2
